phase_prompt.label: Phase 3
phase_prompt.summary: Fully active system with bioluminescent algae, floating glyphic lanterns, and synchronized machinery
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Depict the Abay environment at operational peak: crystalline conduits blaze with intense light, glyphs pulse in perfect rhythm; floating glyphic lanterns drift along the river, reflecting off bioluminescent algae; bronze machinery hums in sync, and the basalt cliffs gleam with a wet sheen under a twilight sky.
